How it works

1. Sign up & grab cards

Joining is free. Order cards for just $5 each with free shipping - as many as you want. That's your only cost, and it's fully refundable.

2. Sell them for $50

Walk into local shops, show the card, close the sale. You sell each one for $50 and keep $30. Add them to Autopilot ($15/mo) and you earn $5/month for a year on top.

3. Get paid every week

Your earnings are paid out weekly by PayPal. Card commissions and monthly residuals, straight to your account.

Questions

Straight answers.

Is there any risk or upfront cost?+

None. Joining is free. The only money you put in is $5 per card (with free shipping), and even that is 100% refundable - if you don't sell them, ship them back and we refund every dollar. You cannot lose money doing this.

How and when do I get paid?+

You're paid every week by PayPal. That includes your $30 margin on each card sold plus your $5/month residual on every active subscriber (up to 12 months per business).

Do I need sales experience?+

No. It's a numbers game, not a talent show. The product demos itself in two seconds and clearly helps the business, so you're not "closing" anyone - you're showing them something they already want. Visit enough shops and the math takes care of the rest.

Why is it such an easy sale?+

Because every owner already knows their Google reviews are everything. The $50 card gets them more 5-star reviews - an easy yes. Then Autopilot ($15/mo) automatically catches unhappy customers before they post and texts the owner, so their reputation runs itself. Both are worth far more to them than what you charge.

Is this a scam or an MLM?+

No. You don't recruit anyone and you don't buy inventory to "qualify." You make money one way: selling a real product real businesses use. And your card cost is refundable, so there's nothing to lose.

How much time does it take?+

Up to you. A few hours a week for side income, or full-time for the six-figure range. The calculators above show exactly how your effort turns into earnings.
